# Puzzle Press

> Browser-based generator for Amazon KDP puzzle books — word search, sudoku,
> mazes, criss-cross fill-ins, and themed crosswords. Produces a print-ready
> paperback interior and a full-wrap cover (spine width computed from the
> book's own page count) formatted to KDP's trim, bleed, and gutter rules.
> Runs entirely in the browser: nothing typed leaves the page except an
> email address at checkout. Free to use — free books carry one small line in the page footer and a cover marked PREVIEW; $19 one-time
> removes both. No account required. Not affiliated with Amazon; KDP is a
> trademark of Amazon.com, Inc.

## Generators

- [Word search book generator](https://puzzlepress.bananafest-destiny.com/word-search-book-generator): themed word search books, 90 built-in word lists or paste your own, graded easy to expert.
- [Sudoku book generator](https://puzzlepress.bananafest-destiny.com/sudoku-book-generator): every puzzle verified to have exactly one solution before it's kept.
- [Maze book generator](https://puzzlepress.bananafest-destiny.com/maze-book-generator): spanning-tree mazes, so every maze has exactly one route.
- [Criss-cross (fill-in) book generator](https://puzzlepress.bananafest-destiny.com/criss-cross-book-generator): fill-in grids solved before being kept, so each has exactly one fill.
- [Crossword book generator](https://puzzlepress.bananafest-destiny.com/crossword-book-generator): themed crosswords with hand-written definition-style clues.
- [Large print word search generator](https://puzzlepress.bananafest-destiny.com/large-print-word-search-generator): 8.5x11 trim, larger grid, fewer words per page, for the senior-gift market.
- [Word list themes](https://puzzlepress.bananafest-destiny.com/word-lists/): 90 built-in themes (all 50 US states, hobbies, holidays, professions, and more), each with its own page.

## Guides and calculators

- [How to make a KDP puzzle book](https://puzzlepress.bananafest-destiny.com/how-to-make-a-puzzle-book): trim sizes, gutter table, spine width, pricing, and the mistakes that get files rejected.
- [Spine width calculator](https://puzzlepress.bananafest-destiny.com/spine-calculator): Amazon's own paperback formula — page count times paper thickness, with no hardcover markup added.
- [Royalty calculator](https://puzzlepress.bananafest-destiny.com/royalty-calculator): KDP printing cost and royalty for any trim, page count, and price.
- [Margin calculator](https://puzzlepress.bananafest-destiny.com/margin-calculator): inside, outside, top and bottom margins for any trim, page count and bleed setting, plus the PDF page size with bleed for every trim (0.125" wider and 0.25" taller than the trim, not 0.25" both ways) in inches, millimetres and 300-DPI pixels.
- [Compared to free generators](https://puzzlepress.bananafest-destiny.com/compare): free puzzle generators, subscription suites, a direct competitor that also builds interior and cover (PuzzleBindery), and doing it by hand — including when each is the better choice.
